violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: two unlabeled squeeze bottle on top of front 1 Dr preptop refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: CFM labeled the two squeeze bottles (chocolate and hazelnut).

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Handled Single-Service/Use Items Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped forks were not stored with the handles up in holder on front customer service counter.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. EHS instructed CFM to place the forks handles up/ facing the same directions.

violations.title: Limited Food Manager - Issued by Health Department
violations.observation: There was no certified food manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The certified food manager was contacted and arrived at the facility with active credentials, during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the handwashing sink, located in the restroom, up front and by the 3 vat, used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: EHS provided a handwashing sign, by email, for the PIC to print and post for correction.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: oatmeal in pot (130F)
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will discard the small amount leftover, and remake the oatmeal for compliance.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: spinach (44F, 47F), kale (47F) in #3.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Hoshizaki 2 Dr under counter cooler (46F)
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the TCS food items by discarding them, and adjusted the temperature control for proper cold holding. PURE GREEN (Inspection Date: 05/30/2025) Page 2 of 3
